founder_decisions.decision: Core is BUSL-1.1 (Licensor certctl LLC; Change Date four years after each version is published; Change License MPL-2.0); pkg/, proto/ and examples/ are MPL-2.0; commercial implementation is isolated under ee/.
No white-label or OEM identity replacement; MSPs operate under the probectl brand.
Customer/MSP self-hosted deployments; no first-party public SaaS.
Offline-signed licensing; no remote license verification.
Pricing is not decided; no price list or pricing model is published. Commercial terms are set per agreement.
Vendor-neutral signed PSA ticket contract; named adapter follows design-partner choice.

counsel_items.deliverable: Exact legal entity, addresses, and complete IP-assignment chain
Inbound-rights policy for ee/ contributions; CLA or equivalent decision
Written MPL boundary, notices, and distribution review
MSA, order form, support schedule, and negotiation matrix
MSP/reseller addendum and end-customer minimum terms
Role-mapped DPA, security annex, privacy notice, and retention schedule
Transfer mechanism and SCC/UK addendum decision for actual support flows
Clearance, filing decision, and no-white-label partner brand guide
Encryption export classification and sanctions process
Written commercial rights schedule for every enabled restricted/unknown external source
Website/sales/support data inventory and cookie/privacy posture

commercial_launch_gate: No paid MSP end-customer deployment relies on draft repository paper or a restricted/unknown external source without counsel-approved written coverage.
